title: Bachelorette Rebound
description: A recently single bachelorette will decide which of several lucky contestants she’ll sleep with for two weeks, and then ghost because she still has feelings for her ex.
altHero: Amy, blonde woman in a red dress at a rose ceremony with the host and three men
alt2: three contestants, one is holding a rose
alt4: Amy hugging two of the men with the host in the foreground
